main_text.l: Gerundium regit casum sui verbi, Socr. φαῦλων ἔργων ἡ
ὃς λόγους τοῦ ξαιπ-τέον, facinorum malorum sermones
αἰσχρὰν ἡ ἀμέλησον ζητέον, animum a-
statuendum: id est, animus amens pro
turpi & immoderato habendus. ἐπεὶ τὸ μέσον τυγχάνει ἀκρως χαλεπόν, καὶ τὸν
δεύ-τερον (φασὶ) πλὴν τῶ ἐλάχιστα λαμβάνειν τῶν κακῶν, cúm medium consequi summé
rū. Quod Latini rariūs imitati: Plaut.

page.notes: Greek passages are printed with heavy diacritics and some letters are doubtful; rendered as best read. The final "Ali-" is a catchword-like hyphenated word at the foot right, kept as a paragraph. Page is a single text column; no margin notes visible.
